title: A novel bispecific antibody targeting TNF-alpha and IL-6 receptor as a potent immunotherapeutic agent for inflammation.
authors: Heravi, Mansooreh; Damough, Shadi; Mafakher, Ladan; Talebkhan, Yeganeh; Nematollahi, Leila; Ghazizadeh, Leila; Ajdari, Soheila
one_liner_zh: 该文设计靶向TNF-α和IL-6受体的双特异性抗体，属于蛋白-蛋白互作体系，无蛋白质-DNA互作，且方法为分子对接和MD但对象无关，故判低分。
abstract: Tumor necrosis factor-alpha and interleukin-6 are proinflammatory cytokines involved in several autoimmune diseases, including rheumatoid arthritis. Although monoclonal antibodies targeting these cytokines or their receptors are successful treatment approaches for autoimmune diseases, approximately 30% of treated patients fail to respond. Therefore, the designation of more effective and versatile therapeutics for simultaneously targeting multiple inflammatory pathways is pivotal. This study aimed to design a recombinant bispecific antibody (BisAb) targeting TNF-alpha and IL-6 receptor based on the complementarity-determining regions (CDRs) of adalimumab and tocilizumab antibodies. The physicochemical properties and tertiary structure of the modeled bispecific antibody proteins were studied through bioinformatics. The interaction of the designed bispecific antibody with human TNF-alpha and IL-6R was computed by molecular docking and molecular dynamics. The recombinant BisAb (60kDa) was expressed in Escherichia coli. The ELISA results demonstrated that the affinity of BisAb and its Ada-scFv moiety to TNF-alpha was quite similar with K(aff) values of 7.7 and 9.4 x 10(-13) M, respectively. The recombinant BisAb and Toci-scFv also represented similar affinities towards IL-6R (K(aff) values of 1.65 and 1.87 x 10(-12) M), closely comparable with the parental tocilizumab antibody. A dose-dependent neutralization of TNF-mediated cytotoxicity was also observed on L929 cells. Decreased phosphorylation of signal transducer and activator of transcription 3 (STAT3) was determined through western blotting with specific antibodies, indicating the blockade of IL-6 receptors before the preincubation with IL-6. The designed BisAb, a minimized biotherapeutic molecule, could successfully target two main ligands (IL-6R and TNF-alpha) involved in rheumatoid arthritis and many inflammatory/infectious diseases. KEY POINTS: * A new bispecific antibody was designed to target TNF-alpha and IL-6R. * In silico studies confirmed the physicochemical and structural properties of BisAb. * The best-modeled protein was recombinantly expressed in Escherichia coli. * BisAb significantly inhibited TNF-alpha-mediated cytotoxicity. * BisAb could efficiently suppress the IL-6-related phosphorylation of STAT3 protein.
abstract_zh: 肿瘤坏死因子-α和白细胞介素-6是参与多种自身免疫性疾病（包括类风湿关节炎）的促炎细胞因子。尽管靶向这些细胞因子或其受体的单克隆抗体是治疗自身免疫性疾病的有效方法，但约30%接受治疗的患者无应答。因此，设计更有效且多功能的治疗药物以同时靶向多种炎症通路至关重要。本研究旨在基于阿达木单抗和托珠单抗抗体的互补决定区（CDRs），设计一种靶向TNF-α和IL-6受体的重组双特异性抗体（BisAb）。通过生物信息学方法研究了建模双特异性抗体蛋白的理化性质和三级结构。利用分子对接和分子动力学计算了所设计双特异性抗体与人TNF-α和IL-6R的相互作用。重组BisAb（60kDa）在大肠杆菌中表达。ELISA结果表明，BisAb及其Ada-scFv部分对TNF-α的亲和力非常相似，K(aff)值分别为7.7和9.4 x 10(-13) M。重组BisAb和Toci-scFv对IL-6R也表现出相似的亲和力（K(aff)值分别为1.65和1.87 x 10(-12) M），与亲本托珠单抗抗体密切相关。在L929细胞上还观察到TNF介导细胞毒性的剂量依赖性中和作用。通过特异性抗体的蛋白质印迹法检测到信号转导与转录激活因子3（STAT3）磷酸化水平降低，表明在与IL-6预孵育前IL-6受体被阻断。所设计的BisAb作为一种最小化的生物治疗分子，能够成功靶向参与类风湿关节炎及多种炎症/感染性疾病的两个主要配体（IL-6R和TNF-α）。关键点：* 设计了一种新的双特异性抗体以靶向TNF-α和IL-6R。* 计算机模拟研究确认了BisAb的理化及结构特性。* 最佳建模蛋白在大肠杆菌中重组表达。* BisAb显著抑制TNF-α介导的细胞毒性。* BisAb能有效抑制IL-6相关的STAT3蛋白磷酸化。
